_meta.what: pt-BR names written or chosen by hand (not machine translation). Key = exact English name. Read by scripts/build.py and scripts/build_techs.py, between names.official and names.machine. Rule: a correction (`fix`) beats everything; then official > this file > machine. See data/README-l10n.md.
_meta.built: 2026-11-01: names.recipes.pt-BR.json (recipe names and fixes) + names.wiki.pt-BR.json (the 9 category names with the game's own words) + the 77 GK1 wiki names of names.pt-BR.json (only 'Alchemy' is not covered by the official file). The three old files are in git history.

legend.game-files/official: the whole name is an official game text
legend.wikily-pt/likely: wikily.gg pt-BR name (locale=pt-br: built by the wiki from official item/station names, or the game's own word, field `game`); grade written '(ouro)' like the app, not '(qualidade ouro)'
legend.derived/guess: composed by us from official names (Construir X (Zona), Cultivado no Canteiro de X (maestria Agricultura N), X (fórmula de alquimia)): not a game or wiki text, shown with the 'não oficial' badge
legend.fix/likely: `fix: <reason>`: corrects a typo of the official text; wins over every layer and tier (Translator), shown as likely (no 'official' claim, no badge)
legend.gk1-wiki/likely: Graveyard Keeper 1 pt-BR Fandom page title linked from the EN page; GK2 may word it differently

fields.recipes: the recipe ids that carry this name (ignored by the build)
fields.wiki_pt: the wiki's text, when ours differs (ignored by the build)
fields.game: where the game itself uses the word (ignored by the build)
fields.kind / priority / gameKey: from the old names.pt-BR.json; priority legend: 1 listed obtainable item, 2 station, 3 category, 4 technology, 5 other (buildings, actions, unlisted items...)
